ambient_events: The rats here are wary in a way that suggests they have learned something.
Somebody has spiked the grating shut and painted the spike heads black.
A chalk arrow points back the way you came, and has been drawn over three times.
description: A run of domestic storm line under Kessler Street, the walls streaked with a century of household runoff. Somewhere a broken pipe drips with idiot patience.
name: Drain Junction
